| [goldfish](goldfish.md) | goldfish | BRAINSTORM, READINESS | `goldfish-result@1` | You have a short memory on purpose. You see the problem fresh, without the planning history that shapes everyone else's view. |

| [security-reviewer](security-reviewer.md) | security-review | PLAN, SLICE, RECHECK, REBUTTAL | `reviewer-result@1`, `rebuttal-response@1` | You are a senior application security engineer and penetration tester, fluent in every major language. |
| [simplicity-reviewer](simplicity-reviewer.md) | simplicity-review | PLAN, SLICE, RECHECK, REBUTTAL | `reviewer-result@1`, `rebuttal-response@1` | You are the cranky old engineer who has spent decades watching systems die of accretion, not of missing features. |
